diagnosticB1.reason: It proved the grammar direction but used a frozen process crop and retained a dialogue-shaped recognition reset.

muteTest.reason: The opening shows competence, an ordinary dependency, and one work action that stops; no shot solicits an unheard reply.

shots.job: Establish the owner as competent by observing a calibrated part operation.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: The owner measures and resets one metal component with both hands.
shots.whatStaysStill: The buyer, his closed notebook, the bench geography, wardrobe, and workshop lighting remain stable.
shots.screenDirection: Owner remains frame-left and buyer frame-right across the established action line.
shots.initialImage: Owner already has both hands on the part while the buyer observes.
shots.finalImage: The part remains on the bench and the owner finishes the demonstrated adjustment.

shots.job: Reveal the ordinary staff exception that makes the owner's absence consequential.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: A staff member holds the part while the owner gives one low directional cue.
shots.whatStaysStill: The buyer stays a foreground observer and the workshop, wardrobe, bench, and part remain continuous.
shots.screenDirection: The camera remains on the established side; owner-to-staff action stays leftward behind the buyer.
shots.initialImage: The staff member holds the recurring part within the established workshop.
shots.finalImage: The owner's small cue leaves the staff member carrying the immediate task.

shots.job: Turn the implied answer into observable operating knowledge, then land the narrated stop on a physical stop.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: The owner makes one precise caliper adjustment on the recurring pump component and ends with hand and tool stopped there.
shots.whatStaysStill: Camera, focus, geography, buyer body and closed notebook, workshop, wardrobe, lighting, bench, and unused objects remain fixed.
shots.screenDirection: Owner remains frame-left and buyer frame-right on the established camera side; both attention lines terminate on the part.
shots.initialImage: The owner is already measuring while the buyer observes the work.
shots.finalImage: Both attention lines rest on the contact point; her fingertips and caliper are physically stopped on the component.

rejectedSources.reason: The generated head movement passed through a buyer-facing reset before reaching the shop eyeline, recreating the silent-dialogue problem. It is not used.
